title: First Enchantment
description: A Dalhurst merchant has already paid for a ring of minor protection, and the coin is spent whether the enchantment holds or not. I need a second pair of hands to gather what the ritual takes. Be here for it.

objectives.description: Ask what the ring's enchantment needs
Buy a silver ingot from a blacksmith
objectives.notes: Can be purchased from blacksmith in Dalhurst or Thornfield

objectives.description: Collect three measures of enchanting dust
objectives.notes: Available from magic shops or dropped by magical creatures

objectives.description: Hold the ritual steady at the enchanting altar
Tell Elara the ring is finished

notes: Threat: a botched or late enchantment on a ring already paid for. Giver motive: the Circle takes commissions from Dalhurst patrons to fund itself, and a failed job is money refunded and a customer who doesn't come back. Consequence: unstated on the page - the quest cannot fail, so the stakes named in the description are never actually spent. First Apprentice quest. PREREQUISITE FIX: the value in `prerequisites` was a FLAG name, not a quest id - QuestManager reads that list as completed QUEST ids, so this quest was never available and the ladder was dead from mage_02 down. Moved to `flag_prerequisites`, which is the list of flags that is actually checked; the flag itself is raised by the previous quest's on_complete_flags.
